mcm.book.title: How to Play
mcm.book.what.contents: Backstabbed! is a murder mystery minigame that aims to reimagine the PlayMCM version of Murder Mystery with our own little tweaks to modernize the game and just make things more enjoyable all around.
mcm.book.roles.innocent.contents: %s: Starts with a %s, and on default settings, one %s. Your goal is to survive until the timer runs out or the %s is killed. You can also collect 10 scrap to craft a %s to defend yourself.
mcm.book.roles.gunner.contents: %s: Starts with a %s and a %s. Your goal is to shoot the %s. %s, so don't make the wrong choice! Additionally, any scrap you pick up will disappear from your inventory.
mcm.book.roles.gunner.contents.red: Shooting the wrong player results in you dropping your gun and getting debuffed for a while
mcm.book.roles.murderer.contents: %s: Starts with a %s, a %s, and various other tools. Your goal is to kill everybody before the clock runs out, and avoid getting shot. %s
mcm.book.roles.murderer.contents.red: With multiple murderers, friendly fire is off by default but can be configured in the game options.
mcm.book.roles.murderer.nextpage: Other tools are on the next page ->
mcm.book.roles.playertracker.desc: %s: Tracks the nearest innocent player and tells you how far you are from them, but not in which direction.
mcm.book.roles.adrenaline.desc: %s: Gives you a short burst of speed and jump boost %s
mcm.book.roles.playerteleporter.desc: %s: Teleports all innocent players back to random map spawnpoints %s
mcm.book.roles.scrap.desc: %s: The murderer can also collect scrap, and starts with one. %s
mcm.book.roles.scrap.desc.green: Collecting 10 scrap will give you an additional knife recall charge.
mcm.book.roles.kniferecall.desc: %s: Only appears when you throw your knife. You can use it to recall the knife if you are unable to pick it back up %s
mcm.book.roles.kniferecall.desc.red: (One Time Use, can be refilled but does not stack).
mcm.book.other.p1: We recommend that living players be allowed to discuss amongst themselves and identify the murderer if observed. This however is not enforced by the game and is only a suggestion.
mcm.book.other.p2:
%s While this may make it easier to find players, we find it takes away from the experience.

If custom sounds are too loud or quiet, you can adjust the %s category of your volume settings.
mcm.book.other.p2.red: We don't recommend turning on hitboxes.
mcm.book.voting.desc: Upon logging in to the server, you will be dropped in the %s, which is the hub for voting for maps and queueing.
mcm.book.voting.desc.p2: Head to the left to view the %s for each map. %s will let you vote for that map provided that there is no map selected for a round yet.
mcm.book.voting.desc.p3: Once voting is done, enter the %s to the right of the posters and %s to queue up. You'll be wearing %s if you are queued.
mcm.book.autoqueue.desc: Alternatively, right clicking your %s will enable your %s, which will automatically put you in the queue for every game. Right click your %1$s again to toggle off.
mcm.book.autostart.desc: If %s is enabled, the game will automatically start once a map is selected and at least 4 players are queued. Otherwise, you can start the game by right clicking the %s.
mcm.book.spectate.desc: To %s a game, head to the end of the hall with the movie posters and %s. Pressing the up button will bring you the second floor, where you can take a %s above the theater to spectate.
